newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama reopens state phone sale bidding process.
newsitem.headline: Panama reopens state phone sale bidding process.

text.p: Panama reopened Monday the pre-qualification process for the sale of its state-run telephone company to allow more bidders to participate, a Treasury Ministry spokesman said.
Interested companies have until October 14 to present documents for the 49 percent sale of Panama's National Telecommunications Institute (INTEL), the spokesman said Monday.

The INTEL privatization process was derailed this summer when key bidder SBC International pulled out, opting to participate in Brazil's more lucrative market, where at least 15 telecommunications sales are planned.
The withdrawal left GTE Corp the only company qualified to participate.
INTEL's value is estimated at $2 billion with assets of some $450 million.
The spokesman did not have further details on when the sale would be finalized.
